About this item

  • WHY CHOOSE AHAM VERIFIDE AIR PURIFIERS: AHAM (Association of Home Appliance Manufacturers) is an ANSI-accredited organization that sets strict standards for appliance performance. Air purifiers with the AHAM VERIFIDE seal have been independently tested for air cleaning performance and energy efficiency. When you choose an AHAM certified air purifier, you're choosing a product trusted for reliable and effective indoor air quality improvement
  • HIGH-PERFORMANCE AIR PURIFICATION: A powerful 56W high-torque motor and 143 CFM CADR delivers fast, effective cleaning. The Levoit Original Filter is HEPA-grade while operating in Sleep Mode (Based on IEST RP C001.7). Ideal for home, bedroom, or office
  • AHAM VERIFIDE, PROVEN PERFORMANCE: AHAM VERIFIDE with a CADR (Clean Air Delivery Rate) rating of 143 CFM for smoke, 153 CFM for dust, and 167 CFM for pollen—refreshing air in a 222 ft² room 4.8 times per hour and a 1,073 ft² room once per hour
  • GENUINE REPLACEMENT FILTERS: For the best performance and longest lifespan, use official Levoit filters designed specifically for Levoit air purifiers. Levoit replacement filters ensure the best fit and high-efficiency filtration, while off-brand filters may be unreliable and may damage your Levoit air purifier
  • FIND COMFORT: Our filter has strong filtration performance of fine particles. 99.97% filtration efficiency for 0.1 to 0.3μm airborne particulates, including pollen, dust, and animal dander allergens. Tested by an independent lab
  • WHISPER-QUIET AIR CLEANER: Select Sleep Mode at night and forget all about your air purifier while you sleep. QuietKEAP Technology reduces noise levels to a near-silent 24dB in Sleep Mode
  • UNDISTURBED OPERATION: The display lights can be turned off to enjoy a perfect night without being distracted by the light. The display also features a timer for 2, 4, 6, or 8 hours as well as a check filter indicator
  • CERTIFIED SAFE FOR HOME USE: The Core 300-P is AHAM verified, FCC Certified, ETL Listed, and CARB Compliant for California indoor air quality standards. Notes: The voltage of the air purifier is 120V and is suitable for use only in the United States

Product Description

Notes: *Our filter has a strong filtration performance of ultra fine particles. 99.97% filtration efficiency for 0.1~0.3μm airborne particulates, including pollen, dust, and animal dander allergens. Disclaimer: Tested by an independent lab. CADR and Coverage area are calculated based on Levoit's Original Filters and are not applicable to other replacement filters.

Notes: *Levoit Original Filter is HEPA-grade while operating in Sleep Mode, as tested by an independent lab.

Notes: *For the best performance and longest lifespan, use official Levoit replacement filters.

Notes: *We recommend replacing your filters every 6 to 8 months.

Notes: *The voltage of the air purifier is 120V and is suitable for use only in the United States. *Only the Core 300S-P features smart connectivity and Auto Mode. The Core 300-P and Core P350-P do not include Auto Mode and require manual fan speed control.

Notes: *Keep the power cord away from pets to stop chewing and other cord damage. Do not use this product if the power cord or plug gets broken.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
The Tiny Dust Assassin
I bought this Levoit Core 300 because my house apparently produces dust as a hobby. Between old windows, HVAC drama, plants plotting in the corners, and parents who think opening every door at once is a ventilation strategy, I was losing the battle. This little cylinder showed up looking innocent and underqualified. I was wrong. The good: 1. Drastically reduced dust in my home. 2. Quiet enough that I forget it's running. 3. Night mode is fantastic for bedrooms. 4. Small footprint and easy to move around. 5. Gets personally offended by cooking smells, candles, and air fresheners and immediately starts working overtime. 6. Made me realize just how much junk was floating around in my air. After running these 24/7 along with new windows and HVAC upgrades, the dust in my house dropped dramatically. Independent testing generally finds the Core 300 performs well in bedrooms and smaller rooms, which matches my experience. The bad: 1. Replacement filters aren't free. Apparently clean air has a subscription fee. 2. No fancy air quality sensor or automatic mode on this model. You have to push buttons yourself like some sort of peasant. 3. If you burn candles or spray air freshener, this thing acts like you've committed a personal betrayal. 4. Not ideal for huge open-concept spaces. It's happiest in bedrooms and smaller rooms. Final verdict: If you're expecting this to transform your home into a sterile NASA clean room, calm down. But if you're tired of dusting the same surface every 12 minutes and wondering where all that dust came from, this little air purifier punches way above its weight. Would buy again. In fact, I already did. Bought 3. "The dust disappeared. My plants are thriving. The purifier judges my cooking. We have reached an understanding." 🤣🌿💨

    I only just got this yesterday and used it last night for the first time but I feel compelled to write a quick review already. This thing is a game. changer. Ever since moving to Texas, I suffer from terrible seasonal allergies. I never have in my life until now (turns out I'm allergic to a handful of trees that are native around here. Fun.) Some years are worse than others but this year is baaad. For the past few weeks my mornings have had me waking up congested and unable to breathe, blowing wads of snot out of my nose (sorry!), and with a itchy/scratchy sore throat. First thing I do is take an allergy pill and wait in misery until it finally seems to kick in around mid morning. (I've had a terrible time finding meds that work too. It just sucks.) I don't know why I never thought to get an air purifier. I guess when I thought of air purifiers I'd always think of the fancy Dyson ones that cost hundreds of dollars. I mean, puh-lease. Not happening. Then I found this little guy. Had great reviews, was the perfect little size for our master bedroom (216sqft), and reasonably priced with reasonably priced replacement filters. In a plee of desperation I talked my husband into us trying it. It got in yesterday (quicker than expected, yay!). I immediately unboxed it upon getting home from work and plugged it in. It says you only need to run it for about 15-20 minutes on high to cycle the room but I set that little baby on high with a two hour timer and let it run. When it was time for bed, I set the 6 hour timer on sleep mode. The sleep mode is great. It's a lot more quiet than I expected. I still expected to be able to hear a little white noise from it (which doesn't bother me at all) but unless I lift my head off the pillow and really listen, I can only just baaarely hear it. And I have it on my side of the bed about 3 feet away. Our home air system is louder than it on sleep mode. If you enjoy white noise, you could probably just run it on low and be fine. It has a button to turn off the indicator lights at night too so you don't have bright lights keeping you awake if that's a problem for you. Anyway, I woke up this morning with NO allergy symptoms. None. No congestion, absolutely clear nasal passages, and NO sore throat at all! I'm blown away. I'll try to come back and revise this review if my opinion changes but after the first night and the relief I was FINALLY able to feel from my allergies this morning I absolutely rate this thing 5 stars. Worth every penny!

    Bought one for my mom and one for my sister in law. Good thing I bought it for my sister in law because a couple months later the devastating wildfire in the Palisades of Los Angeles happened. So the entire LA county was full of smoke. Hopefully it helped but I'm not entirely sure how well it cleans the air because the amount of air that gets pushed out the top is not as forceful as my own air filters at home. My decades old Hunter air purifier has a ton more air flow it's almost like a high power fan. But I think it is able to move so much air because it doesn't have a pre-filter like all the new air purifiers use. It just uses replaceable HEPA filters and I know it works because I see all the dust it catches in the filter before I have to replace it.

    As for the Levoit it has a pre-filter which catches most of the dust and dirt but you never know how much actually gets through to the actual HEPA filter.

    I recommend the Levoit for smaller bedrooms, it's too small to do anything in a large room. At least it's fairly quiet on the lowest and middle setting.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Pet Odor and old house odor, bye bye!
    Reviewed in the United States on May 19, 2026
    Color: WhiteStyle: Core 300-P 1Pack
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Edit to original review: it’s been several months at this point and I have two in our small farmhouse. They work amazing, best purchase we’ve made.

    So far: it’s perfect, surpassed all expectations, ALL.

    Backstory: we’re living in a house from the late 1800s, that has been dormant for about ten years until we moved in a couple years ago. We have five pets, four cats which are strictly indoor and use an automatic litter box (Popur S7 which does great for the smell, it can only do so much though) and one fat, lazy, stinky pitbull. The house is musky, it’s old, it had way too much mold in the detached basement when we moved in. And the pets? They stink bad too, this is coming from someone who is very particular about the house smelling good. The litter box is horrible, the dog is gross, the house is old.

    I went searching for an air purifier, I’ve been wanting the SHARK never change, but couldn’t break down and buy it for $300. Didn’t try it out, can’t say if it’s good or not.

    While I was looking at reviews, I found the shark had only 5,000 reviews on Amazon, and it was at 4.3 stars. Okay, that’s not too bad. But this Levoit one had over 100,000 reviews and 4.8 stars. That’s nuts in comparison. I done a lot of looking on Reddit and found that the shark wasn’t even mentioned in the majority of good quality reviews, so I disregarded it.

    This specific one happened to be in budget and also has amazing reviews.

    We received it last night and set it up this morning, yep this morning, in our cat’s litter box room which is also unfortunately our closet. That room is the worst room of the house in my opinion. It’s been running for about 6 hours and I already notice a huge impact. It’s easier to breath, the air doesn’t feel so heavy, and the litter box is nonexistent, even right after they use it. Hubby sprayed cologne on himself and not 20 seconds later I walked in and it was gone, already sucked away. I put a box fan on it to help circulation and have it on 3.

    I’m buying another. Maybe two more. If I remember I’ll come back and review again when it gets a little later in the month. We’re leaving for vacation next Monday, so I’m curious how it will hold up against the cats stagnant litter box, which usually stinks pretty bad when we get home after a week.

    TLDR; Amazing for pet odor, amazing for muskiness. Perfect and worth every penny.

    We have 2 in our house and looking to purchase a 3rd. Love these things! Ours run all the time and after a couple of years are still going strong! I've recommended them to quite a few people. I can't attest to any personal allergy relief since my immediate family doesn't really suffer from much (maybe due to the purifiers) but I do feel a peace of mind having them in our home, especially with pets! Does a great job to trap dust and debris. I am always very surprised to find how much these things pick up when I check/change the filter. I also appreciate the white noise that it gives off. We do run ours on the 3 setting most days and it provides a nice background noise, which is a personal preference for my family. There are 2 other lower settings which are much much quieter. The purifier is easy to use and easy to maintain (filters can be a pricey). I will actually clean the filter a few times before purchasing new and have found that works great for us and saves an extra buck. We have two white ones and find that they look nice and blend in well with the rooms they are placed in. One of the purifiers is in a space between the living room and kitchen area (most traffic and use) and the other is near our home office and entry. I feel that they do a good job for the space size. Would definitely recommend!

    I love the Levoit Air Purifier! It is very quiet all of the time, but if you use the night time sleep mode, you can just barely hear it at all. The fan has three speeds as well as the sleep mode. You can set the sleep mode for up to 8 hours, the best I remember. I do use sleep mode but not with the timer. You can turn off the display panel and I do that at night because I prefer a totally dark room. I run it all day on low and so far, a week out from getting it and setting it up, there are no signs of anything that needs to be cleaned from the outside as I've seen in other reviews. I don't have any pets, just nasty carpet. I call it nasty, because all carpet is nasty to me. I dislike carpet so much! I don't have a choice, though. I think the filter is supposed to last around six months, so we shall see. I bought a replacement filter when I bought the purifier and several filters for the humidifier, as well. It looks like I may have to change the Humidifier filter once a week as a week out, it is starting to turn brownish-yellow around the top of it. I don't smoke and do try to keep an extremely clean place, so not sure what the discoloration is. I'm the only one who has ever lived here. I use distilled water but also bought the demineralization kit and extra filters for the humidifier in case I run out of distilled water and have to use tap water. I clean the humidifier every day. It's not hard to do once you do it. I love the modern look and it is built very well. It's really not hard to use at all. I believe it is super effective combined with my also Levoit Humidifier. I have them on opposite sides of my small bedroom as I couldn't put my humidifier under the smoke alarm. My skin feels much softer and cleaner using the both of them. I could instantly tell a difference in how well I could breathe using the them. As before purchasing them, I couldn't breathe out of my nose at all. The humidity is brutal here. I have been able to get the humidity down to 58, which is something the local meteorologist said couldn't happen in these heatwave temperatures! Ha! I only use GENUINE LEVOIT filters and they're a bit more costly, but I prefer to use the real deal and have less problems/headaches. It can be a bit catchy to find them on Amazon and the generic ones keep popping up; however, I went straight to the Levoit store to get the genuine ones. Blessed to be able to somewhat better control my Asthma and all-season Allergies with the help of these two awesome products! Thank you, Amazon and Levoit! Sorry for combining reviews but I need to do a copy and paste for the humidifier as it will save me time doing it this way.

    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Amazing! I bought this to handle dust, pet dander, and pet odor. I’ve had it for 6 months already and it has been so effective at reducing the amount of dust in the home. (See the attached photo from when I just swapped out the filter at 6 months. Crazy how much it’s picking up even when I vacuum twice a week).

    It’s not a perfect solution for pet odor. You definitely need to stack this as a solution with regular pet bedding cleaning and opening windows occasionally but overall it helps with baseline smells.

    It’s relatively quiet on the second highest setting. The highest setting is as loud as a white noise machine on a medium setting (so if you have a baby like I do this could be a two in one air purifier and sound machine).

    Overall I would definitely recommend to make keeping your home clean a bit easier! I bought two of them - one for my home office where my dog sits in there all day with me and one for the master bedroom. I’m not sure how it would work in much larger spaces but it works well in medium-sized bedrooms.

About this Item

  • WHY CHOOSE AHAM VERIFIDE AIR PURIFIERS: AHAM (Association of Home Appliance Manufacturers) is an ANSI-accredited organization that sets strict standards for appliance performance. Air purifiers with the AHAM VERIFIDE seal have been independently tested for air cleaning performance and energy efficiency. When you choose an AHAM certified air purifier, you're choosing a product trusted for reliable and effective indoor air quality improvement
  • HIGH-PERFORMANCE AIR PURIFICATION: A powerful 56W high-torque motor and 143 CFM CADR delivers fast, effective cleaning. The Levoit Original Filter is HEPA-grade while operating in Sleep Mode (Based on IEST RP C001.7). Ideal for home, bedroom, or office
  • AHAM VERIFIDE, PROVEN PERFORMANCE: AHAM VERIFIDE with a CADR (Clean Air Delivery Rate) rating of 143 CFM for smoke, 153 CFM for dust, and 167 CFM for pollen—refreshing air in a 222 ft² room 4.8 times per hour and a 1,073 ft² room once per hour
  • GENUINE REPLACEMENT FILTERS: For the best performance and longest lifespan, use official Levoit filters designed specifically for Levoit air purifiers. Levoit replacement filters ensure the best fit and high-efficiency filtration, while off-brand filters may be unreliable and may damage your Levoit air purifier
  • FIND COMFORT: Our filter has strong filtration performance of fine particles. 99.97% filtration efficiency for 0.1 to 0.3μm airborne particulates, including pollen, dust, and animal dander allergens. Tested by an independent lab
  • WHISPER-QUIET AIR CLEANER: Select Sleep Mode at night and forget all about your air purifier while you sleep. QuietKEAP Technology reduces noise levels to a near-silent 24dB in Sleep Mode
  • UNDISTURBED OPERATION: The display lights can be turned off to enjoy a perfect night without being distracted by the light. The display also features a timer for 2, 4, 6, or 8 hours as well as a check filter indicator
  • CERTIFIED SAFE FOR HOME USE: The Core 300-P is AHAM verified, FCC Certified, ETL Listed, and CARB Compliant for California indoor air quality standards. Notes: The voltage of the air purifier is 120V and is suitable for use only in the United States

Product Description

Notes: *Our filter has a strong filtration performance of ultra fine particles. 99.97% filtration efficiency for 0.1~0.3μm airborne particulates, including pollen, dust, and animal dander allergens. Disclaimer: Tested by an independent lab. CADR and Coverage area are calculated based on Levoit's Original Filters and are not applicable to other replacement filters.

Notes: *Levoit Original Filter is HEPA-grade while operating in Sleep Mode, as tested by an independent lab.

Notes: *For the best performance and longest lifespan, use official Levoit replacement filters.

Notes: *We recommend replacing your filters every 6 to 8 months.

Notes: *The voltage of the air purifier is 120V and is suitable for use only in the United States. *Only the Core 300S-P features smart connectivity and Auto Mode. The Core 300-P and Core P350-P do not include Auto Mode and require manual fan speed control.

Notes: *Keep the power cord away from pets to stop chewing and other cord damage. Do not use this product if the power cord or plug gets broken.
